headline: Germany's Soviet past looms over high-stakes election in Saxony-Anhalt: 'I do not consider Russians to be enemies'
description: Ahead of elections on Sunday, in which the far-right Alternative for Germany could win in this region of the former East Germany, the city of Stendal – where 10,000 Red Army soldiers were stationed during the Cold War – exemplifies the unique relationship between the former German Democratic Republic and Russia.

Yemen's deadliest fighting in years raises fears of return to all-out war
description: Nearly 180 fighters were killed in three days in the southwest of the country, where Houthi forces launched an offensive toward the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait. Four years after the 2022 truce, this outbreak of violence revives the specter of the conflict that has ravaged Yemen since 2014.

headline: Nepal demands greater climate justice amid staggering flood costs
description: The tsunami of mud, debris and ice that devastated the country on August 26 has hit several pillars of its growth, including tourism and hydropower. Damage is estimated at between $4 billion to $5 billion.

headline: Where to find Paris's best veggie burgers
description: Forget beef – there's nothing like a tasty broccoli patty, crispy breaded eggplant rounds or a melt-in-your-mouth plantain fritter to expand the horizons of burger lovers.

headline: French left renews push to raise inheritance taxes, from forced philanthropy to wealth transfer cap
description: From the CFDT trade union to presidential candidates Raphaël Glucksmann and Marine Tondelier, the idea of increasing inheritance taxes is back on the table. The far-right Rassemblement National opposes it. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is considering another option: compulsory philanthropy for large inheritances.

description: Hostile acts attributed to Moscow are multiplying across Europe. On September 3, Copenhagen accused Moscow of preparing 'sabotage actions' against Denmark's defense industry. However, European countries remain divided over how to respond.

description: Ahead of the October 27 elections, tensions are beginning to surface within the governing coalition, particularly between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir. From the right to the far right, political factions are hardening their rhetoric to rally supporters.
